originalAlarm.description: The value written to `&irq` is never used.

presenceCondition:
(and (= CONFIG_TWL4030_CORE false)
     (= CONFIG_IRQ_DOMAIN true)
     (= CONFIG_OF_IRQ true))
model:
(define-fun CONFIG_TWL4030_CORE () Bool
  false)
(define-fun CONFIG_IRQ_DOMAIN () Bool
  true)
(define-fun CONFIG_OF_IRQ () Bool
  true)
reasoning: FALSE POSITIVE: Same file as PRODUCT_124 (6252547b8a7.c, Linux TWL4030). Dead store on 'irq' at line 12 ('int irq = *ops') inside irq_domain_add(), with TWL4030_CORE=false. CONFIG_IRQ_DOMAIN is implicitly defined by CONFIG_TWL4030_CORE (lines 3-5); TWL4030_CORE=false && IRQ_DOMAIN=true is an impossible configuration in practice. With TWL4030_CORE=false, twl_probe() is never called, so the real NullDereference bug (ops=NULL when OF_IRQ=false) doesn't apply. irq is assigned from *ops but never used — simplification artifact.
